description: Contact details of the Data Protection Officer have not been published or communicated to the supervisory authority. Article 37.7 requires publication of DPO contact details and communication to the authority.
applicability: Applicable to all organizations that have designated a DPO under Article 37. Contact details must be publicly available and communicated to the relevant supervisory authority.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of privacy notices, website publications, and supervisory authority notification records.
